mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points over three months signals labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 300), a higher CPIAUCSL index value signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 300, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP level (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 is above 22000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals industrial contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market slowdown regimes (HOUST < 1500), a further decline in housing starts leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1500, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
